title: Publish wolftpm2-tss once tpm-rs is on crates.io
description: wolftpm-tss 0.3.1 cannot be published to crates.io: its 'tss' feature pulls optional git-only deps tpm2-rs-client and tpm2-rs-base from github.com/tpm-rs/tpm-rs (rev a7bf0e9), which have no crates.io version. cargo publish rejects any dependency (even optional/feature-gated) that lacks a version requirement. Only the old 0.1.0 is live; the other 16 workspace crates published at their bumped versions on 2026-07-22. Unblock when tpm-rs publishes tpm2-rs-base/tpm2-rs-client to crates.io, then change the git deps to version requirements and re-run cargo publish -p wolftpm-tss. Alternatives: vendor the needed tpm-rs types, or ship wolftpm-tss without the tss feature/deps.
notes: 2026-11-13: The crate is renamed wolftpm2-tss (c8b0aa4) and is now publish = false in Cargo.toml (1078e71). When tpm-rs publishes tpm2-rs-base and tpm2-rs-client, switch the git deps to version requirements, remove publish = false, and run cargo publish -p wolftpm2-tss. Note: crates.io has no wolftpm-tss crate (checked 2026-11-13); the description above saying 0.1.0 is live appears to be wrong.
